payload.text: On vc's word, in a Desk slot after the ccusage seats' compact (vc's todo 8): vc's two nits on ST0003/WP04 (vc's verdict of 2026-11-13 on 348a1a1..7cac510), neither worth a run before 0.1.9's cut: sessions::parse takes the last NAME=value match, since ps -E prints the environment after the arguments; and verified_token_at refuses before renewing when its profile has neither an email nor an account record to check against.
